subject: german

moments.title: Thus Spoke Zarathustra
moments.body: Nietzsche writes his philosophical novel in bursts of intense work.
moments.takeaway: German philosophy could read like literature.

moments.title: Nietzsche collapses
moments.body: Nietzsche collapses on a Turin street, apparently embracing a flogged horse. He never recovers.
moments.takeaway: Some thinkers leave their work mid-sentence.

moments.title: Nietzsche dies
moments.body: Nietzsche dies in his sister Elisabeth's care. She edits his unfinished work and aligns it with antisemitic politics.
moments.takeaway: Posthumous reputations can be manipulated by family.

now.title: Nietzsche now
now.body: Contemporary reception separates Nietzsche's writings from Elisabeth's redaction. His prose continues to influence philosophy, theology and literary criticism.
now.open_questions: How do we read a philosopher whose name was weaponised?

reflection: Nietzsche's afterlife shows how thinkers can be reshaped after death.
